subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu formally support bot-authored messages by default with automatic sender mentions and inline automatic replies, or should bot-to-bot participation require an explicit operator opt-in?
rationale: Current main incidentally admits bot-authored events, but making delivery reliable turns that dormant behavior into a supported autonomous workflow; code inspection cannot choose the intended default loop exposure and transport policy.

options.title: Preserve admission after identity repair
options.body: Repair multi-app mention identity, retain default bot admission plus loop protection, and explicitly approve automatic sender mentions and inline routing as the supported Feishu contract.

options.title: Require explicit bot opt-in
options.body: Default `allowBots` to false and require operators to enable bot traffic after reviewing loop and delivery implications, with corresponding upgrade documentation and proof.

options.title: Split admission from mention handling
options.body: Land only safe explicit mention normalization now and defer automatic bot admission, backstops, and routing policy to narrower follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Preserve admission after identity repair
recommendation.body: Repair multi-app mention identity, retain default bot admission plus loop protection, and explicitly approve automatic sender mentions and inline routing as the supported Feishu contract.
